notify.ap_already.back: This appointment has already been handled

notify.ap_replaced.back: The time changed during the call; the earlier “{}” is still in your calendar. Please delete it.

notify.ap_sales_voided.back: This was considered a sales call, so the appointment fixed during the call was cancelled: {}

notify.ap_sms.note: Row label; 'संदेश' used for text message.

notify.ap_sms_busy.back: The same message is already being sent

notify.ap_sms_cannot.back: a message cannot be sent to this number, so call them yourself

notify.ap_sms_no.back: Sorry, {} won't be okay for me. Could there be some other time?

notify.ap_sms_off.back: will not be sent (“Send message to caller” is off in settings)

notify.ap_sms_ok.back: {} is fine for me. See you then!

notify.ap_sms_old_app.back: the phone's app is too old to send messages

notify.ap_sms_timeout.back: the phone did not respond (time ran out)

notify.ap_sms_will.back: will be sent when you press accept or decline

notify.ap_time_unconfirmed.back: The caller did not confirm this repeated time; ask them before replying

notify.ap_void_failed.back: The “{}” from the call got cancelled, but could not be removed from your calendar. Please remove it yourself.

notify.ap_what.note: 'What' as a card row label; 'विषय' (subject) is my reading, same as s_matter.

notify.bl_announced_hint.back: Blacklist number: the rejection message was played, then the call was cut (no AI)

notify.bl_declined_hint.back: Blacklist number: rejected right while the phone was ringing (no AI)

notify.bl_declined_reply.back: Rejected while ringing: was not picked up (no AI)

notify.cw_end_hint.back: Call waiting: the phone was on another call, so this call was sent back (no AI)

notify.cw_matter.back: Came during another call; the phone treated it as busy and sent it back{sim}

notify.f_bad_time.back: The time “{}” could not be read

notify.f_callback_no_number.back: There is no number to call back: this task has no contact and the caller's number is empty.

notify.f_callback_send_failed.back: The return call could not be sent

notify.f_callback_waiting.back: The return call has been decided, but the phone's control link is off. See that the phone is connected to Bageo, then confirm again.

notify.f_callback_whitelist.back: The callback number is not in the whitelist. Add it in settings (or the starting part of the number, ending with *), then confirm again.
notify.f_callback_whitelist.note: fixed: Reworded as the beginning part of a number, ending in *. 'शुरुआत' (beginning) does not clearly say 'number prefix'; it should mean 'a number prefix ending in *'.

notify.f_email_no_address.back: This task involves sending an email, but there is no reply address. Add a contact from the transcript, or ignore this task.

notify.f_gmail_missing.back: Gmail is not set up. Enter the Gmail address and app password in settings, then confirm again.

notify.f_openclaw_failed.back: The task could not be handed over to OpenClaw: {} (check OpenClaw's address and token in settings)

notify.g_bad_address.back: The Gmail address does not seem right. Check it in settings.

notify.g_bad_recipient.back: Not sent: the recipient's address does not seem right

notify.g_no_recipient.back: Not sent: there is no recipient address

notify.g_short_password.back: The Gmail app password is too short. Enter it again in settings (it is never shown).

notify.h_ai_ended.back: The AI picked up the call and talked; the call ended normally (the AI said goodbye and hung up, or the caller hung up first)

notify.h_ai_fail_hangup.back: The AI could not connect; the system cut the call and the caller heard nothing

notify.h_ai_fail_voicemail.back: The AI failed; the call went to voicemail

notify.h_reject_hidden.back: Hidden number: the rejection message was played, then the call was cut (the AI did not pick up)

notify.h_reject_list.back: Blacklist number: the “number is not available” message was played, then the call was cut (the AI did not pick up)

notify.h_scam_stalling_off.back: The system considered this a sales / fraud call ({t}); entangling is off, so the AI spoke in the normal way

notify.h_stall_released.back: The system first thought this a sales / fraud call; on the second check it turned out to be a normal call and the AI started talking normally again

notify.h_stall_spam.back: The system considered this a sales / fraud call ({t}), so the AI deliberately kept the caller engaged in conversation so that their time would be wasted
notify.h_stall_spam.note: 'बातों में लगाए रखा' for 'kept the caller talking'.

notify.h_stall_spam_nokind.back: The system considered this a sales / fraud call, so the AI deliberately kept the caller engaged in conversation so that their time would be wasted

notify.h_urgent_failed.back: The caller said it is urgent: the phone called the owner but they could not speak, and the AI told the caller the owner will call back soon; this call was not considered an entangling sales or fraud call, so the thing to do is: call them back as soon as possible
notify.h_urgent_failed.note: Very long sentence; meaning kept but wording may be heavy.

notify.h_urgent_merged.back: The caller said it is urgent: the phone called the owner, the owner picked up and was connected to the caller, then the AI stepped away; this call was not considered an entangling sales or fraud call

notify.h_urgent_transfer.back: The caller said it is urgent and the owner was informed immediately; this call was not considered an entangling sales or fraud call, so the thing to do is: call them back as soon as possible

notify.n_blocked_declined.back: Rejected while ringing: not picked up, no AI

notify.n_blocked_done.back: “{}” was played and the call was cut. AI was not used.

notify.n_repeat_body.back: In the last one minute more calls came from {number}: {count}. They were not sent separately.

notify.n_seconds.note: Full word 'सेकंड' used as the unit.

notify.n_test_body.back: This is a test notification from Bageo. If you are able to read this, this notification channel is working.

notify.s_ai_fail_matter.back: The AI could not connect; the system cut the call after about {} and the caller heard nothing

notify.s_ai_fail_prefix.back: [The AI could not connect; the system cut the call]

notify.s_ai_failed.back: The AI could not connect and said nothing

notify.s_call_back_if_known.back: Call back if you recognize the number

notify.s_listen_recording.back: Listen to the recording in the web console

notify.s_no_service.back: The summary service is not set up

notify.s_no_summary.back: (No summary — see the transcript in the web console.)

notify.s_no_transcript.back: The call lasted about {}; there is no usable transcript

notify.s_see_transcript.back: See the transcript in the web console

notify.s_stall_reply.back: Kept engaged for about {}; gave no information and did not agree to anything

notify.s_stall_topic_kw.back: Sales / fraud call (mention of these words: {})

notify.s_todo.note: 'करने का काम' for the to-do label; used in two h_urgent lines.

notify.tc_confirm_ack.back: Confirmed, the work is in progress…

notify.vm_call_back_to.back: Wants a call back: {} (confirmed by pressing 1)

notify.vm_call_back_unchecked.back: Wants a call back (number not checked)

notify.vm_call_back_unknown.back: Wants a call back on this same number (confirmed with 1, but the number is not known)

notify.vm_decide_callback.back: Decide whether to call back or not

notify.vm_email_to.back: Wants a reply by email: {} (confirmed by pressing 1)

notify.vm_email_unknown.back: Wants a reply by email (confirmed with 1, but the address is not known)

notify.vm_no_choice.back: No way of replying was chosen (the call ended early)

notify.vm_no_reply.back: No need to reply (only a message)

notify.vm_no_transcript.back: A message of about {}; it could not be converted into written form. Listen to the recording

notify.vm_task_failed.back: Voicemail (could not be converted into written form; it is necessary to look at it)

notify.ap_weekdays.back: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun

notify.ap_dt_fmt.note: fixed: Changed to 12-hour %-I:%M %p. Appointment times use a 24-hour clock, but people in India normally write times as 12-hour with AM/PM (the English source uses %-I:%M %p), so this should be a 12-hour format.

notify.ap_end_fmt.note: fixed: Changed to 12-hour %-I:%M %p. Appointment end time uses a 24-hour clock, but people in India normally write times as 12-hour with AM/PM (the English source uses %-I:%M %p), so this should be a 12-hour format.

notify.date_fmt.note: Numeric date used because %b would print English month names.

notify.dt_fmt.note: Numeric date used because %b would print English month names.

call.speech.im_here.back: Yes, I can hear you. Go ahead.

call.speech.still_there.back: Hello? Are you on the line?

call.speech.no_thanks.back: No, thank you, it's not needed.

call.speech.think_about_it.back: I'll have to think about this a little.
call.speech.think_about_it.note: Meaning kept, wording is a loose rendering.

call.speech.wait_one_more.back: Oh yes, there's one more question.

call.speech.no_wait.back: "one minute", "wait a moment", "let me have a look", "hold on"
call.speech.no_wait.note: fixed: Reduced to only the quoted local phrases. The text is a full 'Never say ...' sentence, but the program already wraps this field in its own prompt text ('in <language>: {no_wait}'), so it should hold only the quoted phrases meaning 'just a sec' / 'give me a moment' / 'let me see'.

call.speech.unavailable.back: The number you have dialed is not available right now. Please try again later.
call.speech.unavailable.note: Standard operator wording; the exact local phrase may differ.

call.speech.preview.back: ["Hello?", "Oh, a parcel? Yes, put it outside the door, thank you very much.", "Alright, namaste."]

call.speech.closing.back: verified=false; farewells: [goodbye, we'll meet again, we'll meet again, we'll talk again, have a good day, bye bye]; wrapups: [alright, let's hang up now, we'll talk later, that's all, alright, we'll be going]; ends: ["Alright, thank you, goodbye.", "Alright, we'll meet again.", "Goodbye"]; not_ends: ["Hello, this is Rahul speaking.", "Hello, there is a parcel for you, are you at home?", "Shall we talk later, I still have one more question to ask right now?"]
call.speech.closing.note: fixed: Wrapups now gender-neutral (rakhte hain/chalte hain) and first ends example now says alvida. Wrapups 'ठीक है अब रखता हूँ' and 'अच्छा चलता हूँ' have masculine verb forms only, so a woman's 'रखती/चलती हूँ' would not match (the pack otherwise aims for gender-neutral wording), and the first 'ends' example contains none of the listed farewells or wrapups.

call.speech.hello_again.back: Hello, is the voice coming through?
call.speech.hello_again.note: Asks if the caller can be heard; wording is plain but unchecked.

desktop.adb_failed.back: Could not download. Check your connection and try again.

desktop.adb_need.back: Android tools are needed for phones over USB (about 7 MB, from Google).

desktop.err_addr.back: The address must start with http:// or https://.

desktop.err_save.back: Some settings could not be saved. Please try again.

desktop.locked.back: Enter the password to view your phones.

desktop.no_phone_hint.back: Plug in the phone and open the app. It will start showing up here.

desktop.pw_wrong.back: The password is wrong. Please enter it again.

desktop.r_launch_failed.back: Bageo did not start. See bageo.log in its folder.

desktop.r_offline.back: Can't reach Bageo. Is it still running?

desktop.r_setup.back: {n} settings still remain to be filled in

desktop.set_addr_hint.back: Leave empty to find it automatically.

desktop.set_auto.note: "Start when I log in" means logging in to the computer.

desktop.set_notify_sms_old.back: Update Bageo and the message forwarder to get these.

desktop.set_notify_summary.back: When the call summary is ready

desktop.set_pw_hint.back: Needed only when your console has a password.

console.k_declined.note: fixed: same term as everywhere else (छिपा हुआ नंबर)

console.d_copy_dlg.note: fixed: says conversation like the section name

console.ev_reject_unknown_caller.note: fixed: same term as everywhere else (छिपा हुआ नंबर)

console.f_scam_blind_h.note: Acceptable: "usage" (cost of using the service) is rendered as उपयोग; "थोड़ा ज़्यादा खर्च" would be clearer.

console.ct_import.note: Acceptable: import is transliterated (इम्पोर्ट) but export is Hindi (निर्यात); pair is uneven. Consider एक्सपोर्ट or आयात/निर्यात.

console.ct_imp_drop.note: Acceptable: "छोड़ें" for drag-and-drop can read as "leave/quit"; "खींचकर छोड़ें" is clearer.

console.ct_imp_saving.note: Acceptable: missing auxiliary "है" ("{n} सहेजा जा रहा…"); fine as a short status.

console.save_region.note: Acceptable: "असहेजे" is stiff; "बिना सहेजे बदलाव" is more natural.

console.f_enabled.note: fixed: calls are back in the label

console.vc_bright.note: Acceptable: "bright" (a voice quality) as "चमकदार" (shiny) is a stretch; "उजली/खिली हुई" would be more natural.

console.f_knowledge_ph.note: Acceptable: the English example has two lines (one fact per line, as the field expects); the Hindi example is on one line, so the one-per-line example is lost.

console.rc_env_h.back: Bot and chat information comes from environment variables TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID. TELEGRAM_CONTROL_USERS determines who may send commands.

console.hint_telegram.note: Acceptable: bot "token" is written as टोकन here but "Token" (Latin) in mcp_tok; glossary only keeps Latin Token for MCP, so fine, but be consistent.

console.hint_teams.back: In Teams: channel's ... menu -> Workflows -> "Post to a channel when a webhook request is received", finish the steps and copy the URL you get. Old Office 365 connectors are retired.

console.hint_googlechat.back: In Google Chat: open the space -> Apps & integrations -> Webhooks -> Add webhook, then copy its URL. Needs a Google Workspace account.

console.hint_rocketchat.back: Administration -> Workspace -> Integrations -> New -> Incoming: turn it on, pick the channel and copy the webhook URL.

console.hint_homeassistant.back: Your Home Assistant address, long-lived access token (Profile -> Security) and notify service, e.g. mobile_app_pixel_9 (listed under Developer tools -> Actions).

console.hint_ifttt.back: ifttt.com/maker_webhooks -> Documentation shows your key. Create an applet "Webhooks: When a web request is received" with the same event name; value1 is the title and value2 the message.

console.ev_vm_end_hash.note: fixed: no longer starts with # (also check: L07-pattern)

console.nf_line_token.note: Acceptable: field name kept in English ("Channel access token") while neighbouring token fields are in Devanagari (बॉट टोकन, एक्सेस टोकन); glossary allows keeping on-screen service field names, but the mix is uneven.

console.a2hs_ios.back: iPhone and iPad: Share → Add to Home Screen (Safari).

console.ph_to_ai.note: Acceptable: as a button, "फिर से AI जवाब देगा" reads like a statement ("the AI will answer again"); an imperative like "AI को फिर से जवाब देने दें" is clearer.

console.er_task_ph.note: Acceptable: the second example ("or: ...") has lost its line break, and "suits him" became an unspecified "समय रहेगा" (whose time).

console.er_phone_h.note: Acceptable: quotes the toggle as “AI जवाब देता है”; the English does not quote the label. If f_enabled (354) is reworded, update this quote too.

console.er_list.note: Acceptable: "आपकी AI की ओर से कॉल" is clumsy Hindi; e.g. "AI की ओर से आपकी कॉलें" reads better.

console.er_empty_title.back: No calls made by the AI yet
console.er_empty_title.note: fixed: errand meaning is back, differs from empty_title

console.lang_unreviewed_note.back: This language has not been checked by a native speaker yet.
